evidence.heading: Flyscreen Replacement: Mesh, Frame or Complete Screen?
evidence.observedText: Flyscreen Replacement: Mesh, Frame or Complete Screen? Flyscreen replacement does not always mean a whole new screen. Tell us which windows or doors are affected and whether they are fixed, hinged or sliding screens. The scope identifies mesh, reused parts, replacement hardware and removal. Our photographed remeshing example shows insect-screen work, not glass roller repair or security-screen certification. Is replacement insect mesh a security-screen upgrade? No. Insect-screen replacement does not establish security performance or a security licence. Security products need separate confirmation of their product and qualified-work requirements. A dragging glass panel goes to sliding-door repairs .

evidence.heading: Handyman Cost: Hourly, Half-day & Full-day Bookings
evidence.observedText: Handyman Cost: Hourly, Half-day & Full-day Bookings Handyman cost in Perth depends on the agreed repair list and how the booking is priced. Confirm the duration and any minimum or attendance charge rather than assuming that a half-day or full-day label has a fixed number of included hours. Extra time and newly found work need their price and approval agreed before proceeding. What about materials and supplied parts? Customer-supplied parts still need compatibility checks; missing fixings or unsuitable products can change the scope. Regulated electrical, plumbing or other specialist work is itemised separately and completed by Ellis's own appropriately licensed personnel. Will grouping repairs guarantee a lower price? No discount is assumed. Bring a prioritised list so Ellis can assess which jobs suit the same visit. Compare quotes for the same hours, tasks, finish and material responsibility. For a managed property, use the approval and access checklist before confirming a booking.

evidence.heading: Shower Screen Repairs: Hardware, Seals & Glass
evidence.observedText: Shower Screen Repairs: Hardware, Seals & Glass Shower screen repairs depend on which part has failed. Ellis checks hinge or roller movement, alignment, handles and fixings for a door that catches. A worn sweep or seal needs a compatible profile and a check of where water escapes. These tasks are distinct from replacement of damaged glass or the whole enclosure. Tell us the screen style, which panel moves and whether any glass or wall fixing is loose. Avoid forcing the door or handling cracked glass. Glazing assessment determines glass handling and replacement needs; wet-area leak assessment addresses moisture not explained by the screen seal. Can you replace just the shower door seal? That may suit a serviceable screen if a compatible seal is available and the leak comes from that edge. The quote confirms the part, fitting and any additional work after assessment; a new seal is not a promise to fix every shower leak.

evidence.heading: Paving Repairs: Settlement, Loose Pavers & Drainage
evidence.observedText: Paving Repairs: Settlement, Loose Pavers & Drainage Paving repairs begin with the cause of settlement, loose pavers or raised edges. Ellis checks the affected area, adjoining levels, edging and accessible base before agreeing lift-and-relay work. Tell us where water pools and whether the unevenness returns after previous repairs. Reusing pavers does not remove the need to address failed support or drainage. Confirm the area, use, access width and whether spare matching pavers are available. The quote separates lifting, base preparation, drainage or edging work, replacement pavers and disposal. An older paver match depends on supply and condition; a colour match is not assumed. Does cleaning fix sunken paving? No. Patio and paving cleaning addresses surface dirt, while settlement needs repair assessment. Broader layout or planting changes belong with garden landscaping .

evidence.heading: Roof Leak Repairs: Useful Observations & Safe Access
evidence.observedText: Roof Leak Repairs: Useful Observations & Safe Access For roof leak repairs, tell Ellis the room and location where water appears, the weather at the time and whether it follows wind-driven rain or a recent repair. Staining can show where water emerges without identifying its entry point. We agree safe access and inspect the relevant roof covering, flashings, penetrations and drainage before defining repairs. Use only existing photos or views safely available from ground level; photos are optional. Do not climb onto the roof to prepare a quote request. Building height, roof material, access restrictions and previous repairs help us plan the assessment and identify compatible materials. Should the ceiling be repaired at the same time? Water-entry work and ceiling repairs have separate scopes. Agree how the source will be addressed before cosmetic reinstatement. See our roof and gutter maintenance example and gutter assessment for related drainage work.

evidence.heading: Air Conditioning Repairs: Symptoms & Repair Choices
evidence.observedText: Air Conditioning Repairs: Symptoms & Repair Choices Air conditioning repair starts with the system and symptom. Tell Ellis whether the unit is split or ducted if known, the affected rooms, displayed error code and any weak airflow, unusual noise, water leak or loss of cooling. Existing model details for the indoor and outdoor equipment help identify compatible parts; do not remove covers to obtain them. We assess the fault, equipment condition, parts availability and access before discussing repair or replacement. The quote distinguishes investigation, components, installation changes and any electrical or refrigerant work, completed by Ellis's own appropriately licensed personnel. Brand or model information is for assessment and does not imply manufacturer authorisation. Does poor cooling mean a new system is needed? Not necessarily. The symptom needs assessment before that decision. Confirm the system details and your desired outcome, then use the quote preparation guide to compare the same repair or replacement scope.

evidence.heading: Dishwasher Repairs: Drainage, Leaks & Connections
evidence.observedText: Dishwasher Repairs: Drainage, Leaks & Connections A dishwasher that does not drain may have an appliance fault or a problem at its drainage connection. A leak can also arise inside the machine or at surrounding plumbing. Tell Ellis the model, error code and the stage of the cycle when water remains or escapes; this helps plan assessment without assuming a pump or hose is the cause. The written scope distinguishes appliance diagnosis and compatible parts from supply or waste plumbing work , cabinet access and electrical connection work . Ellis's own appropriately licensed personnel complete regulated work. Stop using a leaking appliance and do not touch wet electrical components. Should I order a pump before the visit? Wait until the fault and model compatibility are checked. Parts availability, removal access and the appliance's condition affect whether repair is viable. Existing photos are optional; a symptom description is enough to begin.

evidence.heading: Oven Repairs: Heating, Fan & Door Symptoms
evidence.observedText: Oven Repairs: Heating, Fan & Door Symptoms For oven repairs, describe whether there is no heat, uneven heating, a noisy or stopped fan, a door that drops or a worn seal. Tell Ellis which settings are affected and the brand, model and fuel type if known. A seal or hinge fault has a different scope from a heating element, control or fan fault; the symptom alone does not identify the part. Assessment checks the fault, serviceable components and compatible parts before repair is agreed. The quote identifies diagnosis, parts, access or removal and any connection changes. Hard-wired electrical work and gas appliance work are completed by Ellis's own appropriately licensed personnel where required. Can you confirm a replacement part from a description? The model and fault still need checking. Share an existing visible model label if available, but do not dismantle the oven to prepare an enquiry. Oven work does not imply repair availability for every other household appliance.

evidence.heading: Carpet Repairs: Patches, Joins & Re-stretching
evidence.observedText: Carpet Repairs: Patches, Joins & Re-stretching Carpet repairs can involve a local patch, a failed seam or join, a lifting edge or re-stretching ripples in otherwise suitable carpet. Ellis checks the backing, surrounding wear, accessible underlay and the damage before agreeing an approach. Tell us whether you have a donor offcut and about any moisture or previous repair. A patch needs compatible material, and wear or fading can make the result visible. A loose carpet may suit re-stretching, while widespread deterioration can make new carpet installation the more relevant enquiry. Repair and full replacement are separate scopes. Can a damaged section be made invisible? Appearance depends on the donor piece, pile direction and existing wear; an invisible match is not promised. Confirm the area, furniture movement, matching material and any moisture investigation in the quote. Use the repair quote checklist to set out the intended result.

evidence.heading: Building Inspections: Agree the Inspection & Report
evidence.observedText: Building Inspections: Agree the Inspection & Report A building inspection needs a stated purpose: pre-purchase, handover, maintenance condition or a targeted visible defect. Tell Ellis the property address, inspection type, access contact, areas of concern and preferred report date. We agree the accessible areas, inspection limits and report deliverable before attendance; timing is confirmed directly. The report records observations, limitations and recommended further checks within the brief. Hidden conditions and specialist systems are not assumed to have been inspected. A repair quote or intrusive investigation is a separate step where needed. Is the inspection report building certification? No. A condition inspection and building certification have different purposes and deliverables. If your request concerns proposed structural changes, see structural engineering assessment . Confirm which document is needed before booking rather than treating every property report as an approval.

evidence.heading: Structural Engineering: Assessment, Design & Construction
evidence.observedText: Structural Engineering: Assessment, Design & Construction Structural engineering assessment examines the stated concern or proposed alteration. Tell Ellis whether the request involves changing cracks, a beam, support, footing or a planned wall removal, and share existing plans or reports if available. We agree the investigation and advice needed before a design or building repair is commissioned. Design may require calculations, drawings and details for the defined change. Construction is a separate work scope using the agreed design and applicable approvals; an assessment booking does not automatically include either design or construction. Ellis confirms the appropriate personnel and deliverables for the brief without assuming a particular individual's credentials. Does an engineering report include building the repair? Only work explicitly agreed in the quote is included. Building work , drafting and certification documentation are distinct tasks. Confirm the project objective, access and documents you need so each stage can be scoped clearly.

evidence.heading: Fence Repairs: Retain Sound Timber & Supports
evidence.observedText: Fence Repairs: Retain Sound Timber & Supports Fence repairs focus on the existing timber fence or side gate. Use new fence building for a complete new or replacement run, and fencing project coordination for several sections, gates and staged interfaces. Can just the damaged section be repaired? That depends on the retained posts, rails and available matching timber. Confirm the affected length, access and approval contact before quoting. evidence.heading: Pest Control: Identification Before Treatment
evidence.observedText: Pest Control: Identification Before Treatment Pest control begins with identification of the activity and affected areas. Tell Ellis where and when you see signs, earlier treatments and any household access concerns. Existing safe photos are optional; leave unknown pests, nests and droppings undisturbed. We confirm whether the identified pest and treatment are within the service scope before booking treatment. The plan records treatment areas, preparation, occupant or pet precautions and any included follow-up. Method and timing depend on the assessment; a general pest enquiry does not confirm every species, a particular chemical treatment or ongoing elimination. Ellis confirms the appropriate personnel for the work, including its own appropriately licensed personnel for regulated tasks. Does treatment include all later visits? Only agreed follow-up is included. Confirm monitoring, return visits and exclusions in the written quote. A building condition inspection and any cleaning have separate purposes and scopes.

evidence.heading: Lawn Mowing: One-off Visits, Regular Work & Long Grass
evidence.observedText: Lawn Mowing: One-off Visits, Regular Work & Long Grass Lawn mowing can be scoped as a one-off visit or discussed as recurring work, with frequency and availability confirmed directly. Tell Ellis the front, rear and side lawn areas, present growth, gate width, slopes and obstacles. Long grass can need a different initial cut and cleanup from a regular maintenance visit; it is assessed before a booking is agreed. Confirm accessible edges, clippings collection or mulching, green-bin use and any extra green-waste removal. Mowing does not include every garden task: use garden clean-up for broader overgrowth and garden maintenance for other agreed care. Is clipping removal included every time? It depends on the written scope. Agree the collection or mulching method and disposal before attendance, especially for a long-grass first visit. Point out known irrigation fittings and debris without assuming mowing includes irrigation-system repair.
